<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the config model (`data_avalanche_config::config_keys` and `FIELD_DOCS`). Don't edit: change the source and run it again. -->

Each key's **On reload** column says what a changed value does through `POST /v1/config/reload`: *applied* in place, a *pipeline restart* (that pipeline starts again from its last checkpoint), or a *process restart* (the reload is refused, naming the key). **Rules** link to the [validation rules](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/) that check the key. `<name>` is a pipeline's name, `<key>` a key the operator chooses. The [configuration guide](/data-avalanche/configuration/overview/) explains the file's structure, `${VAR}` substitution and how `defaults` merge.

## Top level

The file's top level: its version, `globals`, and the `pipelines` map (`defaults` takes the same keys as a pipeline, merged into each, the pipeline winning).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config_version` | integer | — | process restart | [V-014](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-014) | The file's format version. Required; the only version is `1`. |

## `globals`

Settings of the whole cluster, the same on every node.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cloud` | `aws` \| `google` \| `azure` | `aws` | process restart | [V-015](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-015) | The object-storage provider for every bucket in the file. Credentials come from the provider's default chain (instance role, workload identity, environment); the file holds none. On `azure` every `bucket` is a container. |

## `globals.state`

Where the cluster keeps its own state.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket` | string | — | process restart | [V-006](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-006) | The bucket of the cluster's own state: the anchor, config generations, membership and the pipelines' leases. |
| `prefix` | string | `""` | process restart |  | The key prefix of the cluster's state under `bucket`; empty is the bucket's root. |

## `globals.api`

The management API, `/metrics` and the health probes.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | host:port | `0.0.0.0:8080` | process restart |  | Where the management API, `/metrics` and the health probes listen. |
| `auth` | `none` \| `basic` \| `jwt` \| `oauth2` | `none` | applied | [V-016](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-016) [V-049](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-049) [V-050](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-050) [V-051](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-051) [V-052](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-052) | How the API authenticates a caller: `none` (open), `basic` (one user, `admin`), or a bearer JWT (`jwt`, `oauth2`) whose roles map through `role_mapping`. The health probes and `/metrics` never ask. |
| `user` | string | — | applied |  | The user for `auth: basic`, or give `credentials_file`. |
| `password` | string | — | applied |  | The password for `auth: basic`; write it as `${VAR}`. |
| `credentials_file` | string | — | applied |  | A JSON file `{"user": …, "password": …}` in place of `user` and `password`; replace its contents and reload to rotate them. |
| `role_mapping.<key>` | map of lists of string | each role maps to itself | applied |  | Maps the local roles `viewer`, `operator` and `admin` to the IdP's role names; a caller gets the highest role any of its roles maps to. |

## `globals.cluster`

Membership, the hash ring and the pipelines' leases.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tokens` | integer | `128` | process restart | [V-026](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-026) [V-062](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-062) | Virtual nodes per node on the hash ring. The first node pins it in the cluster's state; a node with another value refuses to start. |
| `lock_backend` | `storage` \| `kubernetes` | `storage` | process restart | [V-075](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-075) [V-076](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-076) | What arbitrates a pipeline's lease: `storage`, a compare-and-swap object in `globals.state`. `kubernetes` is reserved and refused in v1. |
| `lease_duration` | duration | `15s` | process restart | [V-094](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-094) | How long a pipeline's lease lasts without a renewal: the longest a dead node's pipelines wait for another node. Pinned cluster-wide. |
| `lease_renewal_interval` | duration | `5s` | process restart | [V-073](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-073) | How often the holder renews its leases; at most a third of `lease_duration`. |
| `lease_safety_margin` | number | `0.15` | process restart | [V-072](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-072) | The share of `lease_duration` a holder keeps in hand: it stops writing before the lease could lapse. From 0 to 0.5; outside 0.05 to 0.30 warns. |
| `rebalance_stabilization` | duration | `15s` | applied |  | How long membership must stay unchanged before pipelines move to a joined node. A dead node's pipelines don't wait for it. |
| `max_concurrent_handoffs` | integer | `2` | applied | [V-074](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-074) | How many pipelines a node drains at once when it hands them off. |
| `max_concurrent_takeovers` | integer | `4` | applied | [V-074](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-074) | How many pipelines a node starts at once when it takes over a dead node's. |
| `drain_timeout` | duration | `60s` | applied |  | The longest a graceful hand-off may take (flush, commit, checkpoint, release) before the next owner replays from the last checkpoint instead. |
| `discovery` | `static` \| `dns` | `static` | process restart | [V-095](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-095) [V-096](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-096) | How a node finds its peers: `static` from `memberlist.join_members`, `dns` from `discovery_dns_name`. |
| `discovery_dns_name` | string | — | process restart |  | The name whose addresses are the peers (a Kubernetes headless Service). Required with `discovery: dns`. |

## `globals.cluster.memberlist`

The gossip (SWIM over UDP). Per-node values come from the environment through `${VAR}`.

Rules for the whole block: [V-122](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-122).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `join_members` | list of host:port | `[]` | process restart |  | Peers to join, as `host:port` of their advertised addresses. Empty, with no discovery, is a single node. |
| `node_name` | string | the host name | process restart |  | The node's stable identity on the ring. On Kubernetes, the StatefulSet pod's name (`${POD_NAME}`). |
| `advertise_addr` | string | the bind address, or the first private IP | process restart |  | The address peers reach this node at. On Kubernetes, `${POD_IP}`. |
| `advertise_port` | integer | `7946` | process restart |  | The port peers reach this node at. |
| `bind_addr` | list of IP address | `[0.0.0.0]` | process restart |  | The addresses the gossip listens on. |
| `bind_port` | integer | `7946` | process restart |  | The UDP port the gossip listens on. |
| `gossip_interval` | duration | `200ms` | process restart |  | How often a node sends its pending membership updates. |
| `gossip_nodes` | integer | `3` | process restart |  | How many peers each round of updates goes to. |
| `probe_interval` | duration | `1s` | process restart |  | How often a node probes a peer. A suspect is declared down after `4 · max(1, log10 n)` probe intervals. |
| `probe_timeout` | duration | `500ms` | process restart |  | How long a probe waits before asking other peers to probe; below `probe_interval`. |
| `push_pull_interval` | duration | `30s` | process restart |  | How often a node exchanges its full member list with a peer, so a healed partition rejoins. |
| `retransmit_factor` | integer | `4` | process restart |  | How many times an update is resent, times `ceil(log10(n + 1))` for `n` members. |

| `sample_ratio` | number | 0.05 with an endpoint, else 0 | applied | [V-097](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-097) [V-098](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-098) | The share of flushes traced, from 0 to 1. |

Azure Blob Storage (`cloud: azure`).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## `pipelines.<name>`

One pipeline: a source database, its tables, and the sink they replicate to. The map's key is the pipeline's name.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-055](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-055) [V-056](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-056) | The pipeline's immutable identity: its state, its default prefixes and its lease are keyed by it. Changing it removes the pipeline and adds a new one. Lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 63. |

## `pipelines.<name>.source`

The source database and the connection to it.

Rules for the whole block: [V-001](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-001), [V-010](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-010).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `postgres` \| `mysql` | `postgres` | pipeline restart | [V-019](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-019) | The source engine: `postgres`, or `mysql` (MySQL and MariaDB). |
| `host` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-008](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-008) | The source server's host name or address. |
| `port` | integer | 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL | pipeline restart |  | The source server's port. |
| `db` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-009](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-009) | The one database the pipeline replicates. PostgreSQL table patterns are `schema.table` within it; MySQL's are bare table names. |
| `user` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | The replication user, or give `credentials_file`. |
| `password` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | The user's password; write it as `${VAR}`. Read again at every reconnect. |
| `credentials_file` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | A JSON file `{"user": …, "password": …}` in place of `user` and `password`; replace its contents and reload to rotate them. |
| `ssl_mode` | `disable` \| `allow` \| `prefer` \| `require` \| `verify-ca` \| `verify-full` | `require` | pipeline restart | [V-020](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-020) [V-030](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-030) | TLS to the source: `disable`, `allow`, `prefer`, `require`, `verify-ca` or `verify-full`. `allow` isn't valid for MySQL. |
| `ssl_cert` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | A client certificate for the source: a path, inline PEM, or `${VAR}`. |
| `ssl_key` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | The client certificate's key: a path, inline PEM, or `${VAR}`. |
| `ssl_ca` | string | — | pipeline restart |  | The CA that signed the source's certificate, for `verify-ca` and `verify-full`. |
| `toast_strategy` | `carry_forward` \| `re_query` | `carry_forward` | pipeline restart | [V-080](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-080) [V-077](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-077) | PostgreSQL: an UPDATE that leaves a large (TOAST) column out keeps its last value (`carry_forward`) or reads the row again (`re_query`). |

## `pipelines.<name>.source.timeouts`

The source connection's timeouts.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connect` | duration | `10s` | pipeline restart |  | The longest a connection may take to set up: TCP, TLS and authentication. |
| `command` | duration | `30s` | pipeline restart |  | The longest a catalog query or command may take. |
| `snapshot` | duration | `6h` | pipeline restart | [V-118](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-118) | The longest one table's snapshot may take; at least `10s`. |

## `pipelines.<name>.source.postgres`

PostgreSQL logical replication (`type: postgres`).

Rules for the whole block: [V-003](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-003).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `publication` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-011](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-011) [V-059](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-059) | The publication the pipeline creates and keeps in step with its tables. Unique per database across pipelines; case-sensitive. |
| `slot` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-011](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-011) [V-058](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-058) | The logical replication slot. Lowercase letters, digits and `_`; unique per server (host and port) across pipelines. |
| `auto_cleanup` | boolean | `true` | applied |  | Drop the slot and the publication when the pipeline is removed or its `id` changes. |
| `heartbeat` | duration | `60s` | applied |  | How often the pipeline confirms its position to the server; a stream silent for three heartbeats, while the heartbeat's reads of the slot fail or find no reader, is reconnected. |
| `slot_management` | `managed` \| `require_existing` | `managed` | pipeline restart | [V-102](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-102) [V-103](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-103) | `managed` creates the slot when absent; `require_existing` uses a slot a DBA created and needs `auto_cleanup: false`. |
| `slot_on_orphan` | `halt` \| `adopt_resnapshot` | `halt` | applied | [V-102](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-102) | A slot that exists with no state of the pipeline's: `halt` refuses to start, naming it; `adopt_resnapshot` takes it over and starts from the current position, snapshotting as `snapshots.mode` says (none under `never`). |
| `max_wal_lag_bytes` | byte size or `null` | `null` | applied | [V-104](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-104) | Halt the pipeline when its slot holds more WAL than this, to protect the server's disk; at least `64MiB`. `null` only reports `wal_lag_bytes`. |

## `pipelines.<name>.source.mysql`

The MySQL or MariaDB binlog stream (`type: mysql`).

Rules for the whole block: [V-003](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-003).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `replication_type` | `binlog` \| `gtid` | `gtid` | pipeline restart | [V-021](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-021) | `gtid` follows GTIDs and survives a failover (MySQL `gtid_mode=ON`, MariaDB `gtid_strict_mode=1`); `binlog` follows file and position, and halts `BINLOG_SOURCE_CHANGED` when the server changes. |
| `tinyint1_as_bool` | boolean | `true` | pipeline restart |  | Read `TINYINT(1)` columns as booleans. |
| `tinyint1_detection` | `information_schema` \| `none` | `information_schema` | pipeline restart | [V-081](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-081) | Where `TINYINT(1)` is recognised: the catalog (`information_schema`), or `none` to read every `TINYINT` as an integer. |
| `binlog_purge_action` | `error` \| `re_snapshot` | `error` | applied | [V-105](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-105) | When the server purged the binlog the pipeline must resume from: `error` halts; `re_snapshot` starts from the current position, snapshotting as `snapshots.mode` says (none under `never`). |
| `server_id` | integer | derived from the pipeline's id, in 2147483648…4294967295 | pipeline restart | [V-120](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-120) | The replica id the binlog stream registers with; each pipeline needs its own, or the server ends one of the streams. |
| `heartbeat` | duration | `60s` | applied | [V-121](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-121) | How often an idle server sends a binlog heartbeat; a stream silent for three heartbeats, while the heartbeat's checks fail or find no binlog dump of its connection on the server, is reconnected. |

## `pipelines.<name>.tables`

Which tables replicate, and per-table settings. Per-table keys name the table exactly: `schema.table` on PostgreSQL, the bare name on MySQL.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `include` | list of string, or `null` | — | pipeline restart, if the table set changes | [V-007](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-007) [V-064](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-064) [V-117](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-117) | The tables to replicate, as globs: `schema.table` on PostgreSQL (`public.*`), bare names on MySQL (`orders`, `payment_*`). `*` stays within one name. Required, non-empty. |
| `exclude` | list of string, or `null` | `[]` | pipeline restart, if the table set changes |  | Globs subtracted from `include`, in the same form. |
| `column_type_overrides.<key>` | map of logical type | — | pipeline restart | [V-078](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-078) | A column's target type, keyed `table.column`, in the sink-neutral grammar: `int64`, `decimal(38,10)`, `string`, `timestamp_tz`, `list<int32>`… |
| `numeric_overflow_action` | `string` \| `error` | `string` | pipeline restart | [V-082](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-082) [V-079](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-079) | A `numeric` wider than 38 digits: `string` writes its text; `error` halts the table. |
| `primary_key.<key>` | map of lists of string | — | pipeline restart |  | The key columns of one table, in place of its primary key (for example a unique index behind `REPLICA IDENTITY USING INDEX`). Changing it means a re-snapshot. |

## `pipelines.<name>.tables.snapshots`

Copying a table's existing rows before its changes stream.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `never` \| `initial` \| `always` \| `dump_always` \| `dump_initial` | `never` | pipeline restart | [V-022](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-022) | When a table is copied before its changes stream: `never`, `initial` (once, for a table with no confirmed position), `always` (at every start), or `dump_initial` and `dump_always` (the same, with no streaming after). |
| `parallelism` | integer | `1` | applied | [V-027](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-027) [V-038](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-038) | How many tables are snapshotted at once. More than 4 warns: each PostgreSQL snapshot holds several connections. |
| `chunk_size` | integer | `10000` | applied | [V-108](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-108) | Rows per snapshot chunk; a snapshot resumes from its last committed chunk. |
| `overrides.<key>` | map of `never` \| `initial` \| `always` \| `dump_always` \| `dump_initial` | — | pipeline restart | [V-022](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-022) | A snapshot mode for one table, named exactly (no globs). |

## `pipelines.<name>.sink`

The table format and where the tables are written.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `iceberg` \| `delta` | — | pipeline restart | [V-083](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-083) [V-091](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-091) | The table format: `delta`. Required, with no default. `iceberg` is accepted but refused at start: the Iceberg sink ships in v2. |
| `write_mode` | `mirror` \| `changelog` | `mirror` | pipeline restart | [V-089](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-089) | `mirror`: the tables mirror the source, rows upserted and deleted. `changelog` is reserved. |
| `bucket` | string | — | pipeline restart | [V-012](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-012) | The bucket (Azure: container) of the pipeline's tables. |
| `prefix` | string | the pipeline's id | pipeline restart |  | The key prefix of the pipeline's tables; each table is `<prefix>/<schema>/<table>/`. |
| `max_transaction_batch_rows` | integer or `null` | `null` | applied | [V-109](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-109) | Commit a source transaction larger than this in slices (its resume point stays at its start). `null` keeps every transaction whole. |
| `max_transaction_buffer_bytes` | byte size | `1GiB` | applied | [V-110](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-110) | The most one transaction may buffer. Without slicing, reaching it halts the pipeline rather than run the node out of memory. |
| `buffer_capacity_rows` | integer | `200000` | applied | [V-111](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-111) | The capacity of the pipeline's internal queues: when the sink can't keep up, reading stops once they fill. |

## `pipelines.<name>.sink.flush`

When buffered changes are committed: the first trigger met fires.

Rules for the whole block: [V-035](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-035).

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | integer or `null` | `30` | applied | [V-036](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-036) [V-037](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-037) | Flush when the oldest buffered change is this old. `0` flushes at every transaction; `null` turns the trigger off. |
| `rows` | integer or `null` | `100000` | applied |  | Flush at this many buffered rows; `null` turns the trigger off. |
| `bytes` | byte size or `null` | `512MiB` | applied |  | Flush at this much buffered data; `null` turns the trigger off. |

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `column_mapping` | `none` \| `name` | `none` | pipeline restart | [V-092](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-092) | Delta column mapping for new tables; `name` is refused in v1, because delta-rs can't add a column to a column-mapped table. |
| `checkpoint_interval` | integer | `10` | pipeline restart |  | Commits between Delta checkpoints, for new tables (`delta.checkpointInterval`). |
| `log_retention` | duration | `30d` | pipeline restart |  | How long the Delta log keeps its entries, for new tables (`delta.logRetentionDuration`). |
| `timestamp_ntz_as` | `timestamp_ntz` \| `timestamp` \| `string` | `timestamp_ntz` | pipeline restart | [V-114](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-114) | The Delta type of a `timestamp without time zone` column in a new table: `timestamp_ntz` (reader 3 / writer 7), `timestamp` (as a UTC instant), or `string`. |
| `table_properties.<key>` | map of string | — | pipeline restart |  | A table property for new tables; a `delta.*` key must be on the allow-list. |
| `merge_memory_limit` | byte size or `null` | `null` | pipeline restart | [V-119](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-119) | The memory ceiling of one table's MERGE; at least `16MiB` when set. A MERGE over it halts the table `SINK_REJECTED`. |

## `pipelines.<name>.sink.delta.catalog`

Catalog registration of the Delta tables.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `none` \| `glue` \| `unity` \| `hive` | `none` | pipeline restart | [V-088](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-088) | Catalog registration of the Delta tables: `none` (path-based). The others are reserved. |

## `pipelines.<name>.state`

Where the pipeline keeps its state, when not beside its tables.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket` | string | sink.bucket | pipeline restart |  | The bucket of the pipeline's state (positions, snapshot cursors, status). By default it sits under the sink's prefix, in `.pipeline-state/`. |
| `prefix` | string | the pipeline's id | pipeline restart |  | The state's prefix when `state.bucket` is set; `defaults.state.prefix` is its parent. |

## `pipelines.<name>.schema_evolution`

Applying the source's schema changes.

| Key | Type | Default | On reload | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | applied |  | Apply the source's safe schema changes to the tables; off, any change halts its table. |
| `rescan_interval` | duration | `60m` | applied |  | How often an idle table's schema is read again; `0` turns the rescan off. |

## `pipelines.<name>.sink.iceberg` (v2)

The Iceberg sink is designed but ships in v2: a pipeline with `sink.type: iceberg` validates, and is refused at start while the other pipelines run.

Rules for the whole block: [V-084](/data-avalanche/reference/validation-rules/#v-084).
